# Audit report on the convergence work packages

## Notes, part 1

`evidence-first-analysis` is a dynamic skill of the DS4 Studio agent
to analyse code; the runtime makes the rules hold when the model forgets them.

- the full skill is in the system prompt, followed by a short Core Contract and
  the `evidence_guard` tool contract;
- the Core Contract is re-injected with every system-prompt reminder (token
  distance or tool burst), after every compaction (with a digest of the
  ledger), and on the first turn after a session switch;
  the `evidence_guard` tool changes: `open`, `add_evidence`, `mark_check`,
  `set_reachability`, `set_verdict`, `finalize`, `status`;
- in `block` mode a final answer is withheld until `evidence_guard finalize`
  succeeded and no other tool ran after it; the report must use the ledger ids
  (`EFA-001`) and its `State:`/`Severity:`/`Reachability:` lines must match.

The ledger refuses, with a stable reason code:

A finding with no category (`general`) needs every category check resolved,
because the runtime cannot tell which ones matter. Two withheld answers in a
turn end it with `EVIDENCE_FINALIZATION_TERMINAL` and no candidate text.

With the skill not loaded the gate is off whatever the variable says. Any other
value is a startup error (`ds4-agent: DS4_EVIDENCE_MODE=... is invalid`), never
a silent fallback.

The ledger is session-scoped and lives in the worker, not in the transcript,
so compaction cannot drop it. Saving a session writes it next to the KV file as
`<cache>/<sha>.evidence` (versioned text, metadata only). A finalize is never
persisted: after a switch the session must finalize again. A missing or
malformed ledger file restores an empty ledger and the next turn says so.
